data.title: bn-25c: define v3 canonical positions and safe subscription cursors
data.description: Documents that v3 registry events consume canonical positions while app-visible reads filter them; treats cursors as opaque monotone tokens and keeps v4 gated. Implements safe position() resume semantics across next() prefetch, typed CursorRegressed on resumed cursors beyond the published read end, terminal u64::MAX reads, exclusive watermark wording, and durable-vs-published watermark layering.
